title: Vakazvipira Vakazvipira
intro: Muprofita airemekedzwa aifamba pakati pevanhu, achivadana kuti vauye kuchokwadi. Vazhinji vakatendeuka nekuoma mwoyo, asi boka diki rakazvipira rakapindura chikumbiro chacho ndokuzvipa nemwoyo wese. Vakaedzwa nekusava nechokwadi uye vakashinga kutsvaga rubatsiro rwekudenga. Kuzvipira kwavo kusingazununguki kwakava chidzidzo chisingaperi chekutenda. Vaiva vanaani?
clues: Taiva boka diki rakasimuka kuti ritsigire basa raMwari munguva yekusatenda kwakapararira.
Muprofita anoremekedzwa akauya akatidana kuti timire seshamwari mubasa raAllah.
Muprofita paakabvunza kuti ndiani aizotsigira Mwari, takapindura tisingazenguriri.
Takashinga kukumbira mabiko anoshamisa akatumirwa kubva kudenga kuti asimbise mwoyo yedu.
Muprofita wedu akatiyeuchidza kuti tiremekedze Allah kana tiri vatendi vechokwadi, asi chikumbiro chedu chekuzvininipisa chakakudzwa.
Isu taiva vepedyo vakazvipira vakavimbisa kutenda kusingazununguki pamwe chete naIsa, mwanakomana waMaryam.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
